headline: Binance Security Under Scrutiny Following $6.3 Billion Breach
summary: A $6.3 billion hack on Binance has renewed debates over centralized architecture in digital assets. While centralization enabled the attack, it also facilitated the recovery of $3 billion.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, and major security breaches impact ecosystem trust and regulatory scrutiny.

impacts.name: Binance Coin
impacts.why: Security breaches affecting the Binance exchange create downward price pressure on associated assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Concerns over exchange vulnerability and asset security undermine investor trust across the digital asset platform.
